policy.genealogy: stock_rod -> cutting_event -> fabricated_piece -> installed_member -> leftover -> future reuse link
policy.project_wide_reuse: All leftover pieces remain genealogically linked and searchable across the Narayani building. Automatic matching is limited to AVAILABLE_FOR_FUTURE_SCREENING pieces of the same diameter/grade. A future member BBS/detailing check must approve actual reuse.
policy.reuse: No leftover is automatically assigned structurally; it remains searchable and requires future engineering/BBS validation.

engineering_rules.T12: 3T12 top + 3T12 bottom; terminal development 720 mm; lap 720 mm (60phi); cuts rounded upward to next 25 mm; each cut <=12000 mm
engineering_rules.T8: 2-legged closed T8; 100 mm c/c within 600 mm joint zones; project drawing requires <=100 mm at lapped sections; 150 mm c/c middle.
engineering_rules.lap_location: No lap within a joint, within 2d of column face, or within quarter length adjoining likely flexural-yielding location; no more than 50% steel on either face spliced at a section.

methods: exhaustive 2^8 hybrid configuration comparison over best/base and per-run T8-minimized candidates
optimization.outer_spatial_global_optimality: BEST_VERIFIED; not a mathematical proof over every continuous legal splice placement

t8.rules: 2-legged closed T8; 100 mm c/c within 600 mm joint zones; project drawing requires <=100 mm at lapped sections; 150 mm c/c middle.

independent_validation.scope_note: 86 T12 rods is proven optimal for the selected spatially legal schedule. The outer continuous splice-placement search remains BEST VERIFIED, not globally proven across every legal coordinate.

authority_policy.mainbar_selection_boundary: Final T12 joint-safe cutting-stock solution is GLOBAL. Per-run rows expose source-stored pre-terminal working fabrication/splices only; they do NOT falsely allocate final global T12 cut pieces to selected runs.
authority_policy.rcc_materials: Narayani_PlInthBeam_RCC_MainBars_v0.2.json / exact global source total spatially allocated by source run length and 230x300 section
authority_policy.t8_selection_boundary: Final T8 link counts are explicitly source-stored by run and are additive by selected run.
authority_policy.t8_weight_allocation: Per-run T8 installed kg normalized from frozen whole-network final BBS installed weight / exact total link count; do not recompute with generic d²/162 unit weight.

spatial_db.purpose: Per-run plinth-beam spatial geometry, RCC/material allocation, source-stored preterminal main-bar working demand, and final T8 link allocation for M70 atomic UI.
